title: Red Beans and Rice with Spam
description: This red beans and rice with Spam recipe is one my mom made combining our Minnesota culture, where Spam originated, and Puerto Rico, where my dad is from.
ingredients: 3 (15 ounce) cans kidney beans, with liquid
1 (12 ounce) can fully cooked luncheon meat (such as SPAM®), cubed

steps.text: Bring rice and water to a boil in a saucepan over high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until rice is tender and liquid has been absorbed, 20 to 25 minutes.

Meanwhile, combine kidney beans with liquid, luncheon meat, butter, and onion flakes in a large saucepan. Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat, then reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Spoon bean mixture over cooked rice; serve.
